findings.description: The separator condition was inverted to `not any_prefix_is_slash`, so ordinary options are joined with "; " and slash-prefixed options with " / ", the reverse of the original behavior.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any option such as `--verbose` with `-v` and no slash prefix. The new expression evaluates to "; " because any_prefix_is_slash is False, so the help left column renders as `-v; --verbose` instead of `-v, --verbose`. This changes help output for nearly every option, which users and docs tests would observe.
